proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ n A
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hm : ∀ i : Fin n, (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ω i ∈ A)).card * Fintype.card Ω = A.card * Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) := by
    intro i
    have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ω i ∈ A) = Fintype.piFinset (fun j => if j = i then A else Finset.univ) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
      constructor
      · intro hω j
        by_cases hj : j = i
        · subst hj; rw [if_pos rfl]; exact hω
        · rw [if_neg hj]; exact Finset.mem_univ _
      · intro hω
        have := hω i
        rwa [if_pos rfl] at this
    rw [e, Fintype.card_piFinset, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hp : ∀ s : Finset (Fin n), (∏ j ∈ s, (if j = i then A else Finset.univ : Finset Ω).card) * Fintype.card Ω = (if i ∈ s then A.card * Fintype.card Ω ^ s.card else Fintype.card Ω ^ (s.card + 1)) := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | insert a s ha ih =>
        rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, mul_assoc, ih, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha]
        by_cases hai : a = i
        · subst hai
          simp only [if_true, ha, if_false, Finset.mem_insert, true_or]
        · have hmem : i ∈ insert a s ↔ i ∈ s := by
            simp only [Finset.mem_insert]
            constructor
            · rintro (h' | h')
              · exact absurd h'.symm hai
              · exact h'
            · exact Or.inr
          simp only [if_neg hai, hmem, Finset.card_univ]
          split_ifs <;> ring
    have := hp Finset.univ
    rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    exact this
  have hs : (∑ ω : Fin n → Ω, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ)) = ∑ i : Fin n, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ) := by
    have : ∀ ω : Fin n → Ω, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ) = ∑ i : Fin n, if ω i ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
      intro ω
      rw [Finset.sum_boole]
    simp_rw [this]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_boole]
  have hF : (Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [hs, div_eq_iff hF, mul_assoc, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_comm]
  have hcast : ∀ i : Fin n, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ) = (A.card : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) / Fintype.card Ω := by
    intro i
    rw [eq_div_iff h]
    exact_mod_cast hm i
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hcast i), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (n : ℕ) (A : Finset Ω), (∑ ω : Fin n → Ω, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ)) / Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) = (n : ℝ) * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω)
